The assembly below places all 7 parts. Each storage angle was measured from the part geometry, and each part is rotated back to upright, except the base plate, which is not rotated. Parts are aligned on a pump centre line at x = 600.

**Base plate:** I translated it only, so the centre of its pedestal top face lands at (600, 640).

**Pump body:** Its flanges are stored at 110°, so its axis lies at 20°. I rotated it −110° so it stands vertical. The narrow end goes down and the bulging end goes up, which means the bulge sits under the cap.
- Bottom flange underside: (600, 640).
- Top flange face: (600, 300.9).
- Widest point of the bulge, left side: (523.3, 393.1).

**Cap:** Stored at 55°, so I rotated it −55°, which puts the dome on top.
- Skirt underside: (600, 300.9).
- Lug upper hole: (723.2, 235.6). The lug is on the right.

**Spout:** Stored at about 125°, so I rotated it −125°. Its flange face, the right edge, meets the body's widest point at (523.3, 393.1). The spout points left and its outlet curves down.

**Link bar:** Stored at 160°, so I rotated it −160°.
- Lower eye: on the cap lug's upper hole at (723.2, 235.6).
- Upper eye: (774.8, 87.3).

**Handle lever:** Stored at 35°, so I rotated it −35°. Its two holes then sit level, 174.8 px apart.
- Middle hole: (774.8, 87.3), on the link bar's upper eye.
- Left end hole: (600, 87.3), on the centre line.

**Piston rod:** Stored at 70°, so I rotated it −70°, which makes it vertical.
- Top eye: (600, 87.3), on the handle's end hole and above the body.
- Bottom end: (600, 409.4), inside the bore.
